gloss_en: Port 8080 is hardcoded and the MCP plugin must be started manually after each Revit restart; is there a config file?
title_original: Is there config file for port and auto startup mcp?
question_paraphrase: the port (8080) is hardcoded and user needs to manually start mcp plugin after restart Revit - config file?
phrasing_notes: numbered list of two problems, terse, no greeting
answer_summary: No answer captured; thread open at fetch time.

gloss_en: Proposal for a knowledge-graph memory layer because the flat store_*_data path answered 'done' on 8 of 15 tasks while nothing was stored.
title_original: BIM knowledge graph as an extra layer?
question_paraphrase: benchmark of 15 deterministic BIM tasks: model confidently claimed success without persisted state
phrasing_notes: long structured proposal with bold headings, quantified results (8/15 false done vs 15/15)
answer_summary: Maintainers liked it; asked for TypeScript and integration with ExtensibleStorage instead of side-car Python.

gloss_en: Followed all steps, tried several Revit MCPs, Claude always says it cannot connect to Revit when asked to create a 10 m wall.
question_paraphrase: Claude replies: unable to connect to Revit... will create a 10-meter wall once connected; port 8080 opened, no luck
context_given: Claude blue bar shows server running
phrasing_notes: quotes Claude's own refusal text; lists checks done; no version info
answer_summary: Maintainers asked whether Claude Code or Desktop, what /mcp shows, and pointed to a setup video.

gloss_en: Every command fails with 'Failed to create command instance' even after unblocking all DLLs; suspects duplicate Roslyn dependency copies.
question_paraphrase: bug report template with steps already taken (Unblock-File), log timestamps, suspected duplicate DLLs
phrasing_notes: formal bug template, pastes PowerShell, own root-cause hypothesis
answer_summary: Dependency/version mismatch between two plugin folders suspected; thread continued with maintainers.

gloss_en: All mutating tools (create_level, create_grid, create_structural_wall) fail with a generic error while read tools work.
title_original: All mutating tools fail with 'An error occurred invoking'
question_paraphrase: revit_create_level {elevation:900,name:'GL+900'} returns isError; reads like get_current_view_info work
context_given: reproduced with Python MCP SDK client
phrasing_notes: precise repro steps, tried reboot/reinstall; notes ja-JP UI and ru-RU locale
answer_summary: Reporter found tool args are lost when a fresh server process is spawned per call; persistent stdio session works.

gloss_en: No native stair creation tool; StairsEditScope through send_code needs IFailuresPreprocessor, and a bad tread depth crashed Revit.
title_original: No stair tool + send_code_to_revit can't satisfy StairsEditScope.Commit
question_paraphrase: stairs are the hard case: Error-severity failure hung Revit ~60s then crashed
phrasing_notes: asks for (a) helper and (b) native create_stairs tool; includes API namespace tip
answer_summary: Maintainer shipped send_code improvements in v0.6.2; reporter later switched to another Revit MCP for stability.

gloss_en: Placing a door with create_point_based_element ignores x/y/z and host; the door ends up unhosted at the origin.
title_original: create_point_based_element ignores x/y/z and host for hosted families (doors)
question_paraphrase: wall (0,2000)-(5000,2000); door at 2500,2000,0; FamilyInstance.Host is null
phrasing_notes: coordinates in mm, expected/actual format
answer_summary: Fixed in v0.6.2: host_id param required for hosted families, position verified within 1 mm before commit.

gloss_en: Context gets compacted constantly with local 256k agents and parallel sub-agents because every agent loads the full tool schema list.
title_original: Context gets compacted constantly with local agents and parallel sub-agents
question_paraphrase: large tool catalogs eat the context window before real work starts
phrasing_notes: informal 'kind of - idk', states own plan to group tools
answer_summary: Plan: group tools / lighter discovery step so each agent loads a smaller set.

gloss_en: Cannot start the pyRevit-based MCP server and cannot connect Claude Desktop; README names a server file that does not exist.
question_paraphrase: AttributeError is_mcp_server_running; README says revit_mcp_server.py but repo has revit_api_server.py
phrasing_notes: apologetic opener, pasted traceback, 'I was really looking forward to trying'
answer_summary: Maintainer said it was a repo bug, not user error, and would fix.

gloss_en: create_wall silently uses the first Level in the project and Z=0; propose explicit level and wall type parameters.
title_original: [提案] 強化 create_wall 的樓層與牆型選擇，避免任意使用第一個樓層
question_paraphrase: AI 建牆時沒有樓層參數就取 FirstOrDefault Level，牆建到非預期樓層、無法指定牆型
phrasing_notes: Traditional Chinese, numbered problem list, structured proposal
answer_summary: Merged into main; maintainer found WallType parameter was declared but never read in C#.

gloss_en: Asks preview_dwg_beams to return centerline coordinates so the AI can turn CAD wall layers into Revit walls.
title_original: [提案] preview_dwg_beams 加 includeGeometry 參數
question_paraphrase: 預覽只回傳數量與前5筆寬度，沒有座標，AI 無法把 CAD 牆圖層翻成 Revit 牆
phrasing_notes: zh-TW, tool names in code font, mm units spelled out
answer_summary: Proposed optional includeGeometry flag returning centerlines {sx,sy,ex,ey,width_mm}.

gloss_en: MCP only reaches the DB API, not UI buttons, so AI cannot trigger pyRevit Reload or test a button it just edited.
title_original: MCP 工具無法自動觸發 pyRevit 按鈕 / Reload 功能
question_paraphrase: 用 OSI 七層模型分析 MCP 與 pyRevit 按鈕呼叫的介面隔離
phrasing_notes: academic framing with OSI table; polite honorific from maintainer reply
answer_summary: Maintainer agreed diagnosis (dynamic IExternalCommand, no PostableCommandId) but declined to add to core.

gloss_en: An MEP IFC made by an LLM for testing a downgrade migration will not open in Bonsai or BIMvision.
title_original: Basic (MEP) IFC file cannot be opened
question_paraphrase: header says originating_system OpenAI; IfcProject has 8 attributes instead of 9 (Phase missing)
phrasing_notes: reports which viewers worked; unaware file was hallucinated
answer_summary: Not a Bonsai bug: LLM-written IFC is non-conformant; run validate.buildingsmart.org and loop until it passes.

gloss_en: 23 of 25 ifcmcp tools expose an empty description so the model sees only names and schemas.
title_original: ifcmcp: 23 of 25 tools expose an empty description over MCP
question_paraphrase: FastMCP derives tool description from docstring; no docstring means empty description in tools/list
phrasing_notes: root-cause analysis with code pointers
answer_summary: Confirmed; draft PR adds docstrings to all 23 tools.

gloss_en: Error editing an opening in Bonsai; reporter later shared a ChatGPT research link as a partial workaround attempt.
title_original: error when trying to edit opening
question_paraphrase: traceback plus shared chatgpt.com conversation used for 'some research, that worked kinda'
phrasing_notes: bare title, traceback paste, ChatGPT share link in comment
answer_summary: Link to a ChatGPT session offered as partial help; maintainer could not reproduce.

gloss_en: Wants relative zoom out of floor plan by 15 percent, MEP in perspective full screen, and a straight-on view of a stair section; set_camera presets did not move the camera.
question_paraphrase: Oddiaľ pôdorys o 15 percent. / Ukáž vzduchotechniku v perspektíve na celú obrazovku.
context_given: tools tried: set_camera preset front/back with targets
phrasing_notes: issue written by the AI itself via request_tool; prompts are short Slovak imperatives
answer_summary: Needs relative zoom/pan/orbit and fit-to-visible tool; Claude session picked up the task.

gloss_en: Wants a tool returning the current Revit view as an image so a multimodal LLM can place elements visually and verify changes.
title_original: Feature request: Add a tool to capture the current view as an image (for AI vision)
question_paraphrase: put the sofa here, by the window; verify a change actually looks correct
phrasing_notes: polite thanks, bullet use cases, searched build for ImageExportOptions
answer_summary: Open request; no screenshot tool in v2.2.1.

gloss_en: Asks about support for Revit 2020-2022, which command saves the project, and which command exports the current view as PNG.
title_original: Is it possible to support Revit 2020-2022? Which command to save... export png?
question_paraphrase: 3 numbered questions, non-native English
phrasing_notes: non-native English, numbered, no context about client
answer_summary: Pointed to the sibling repo that supports R20-R24.

gloss_en: Agent retries after a timeout create the same walls/slabs twice; proposes idempotency keys.
title_original: Proposal: opt-in idempotency for mutating tool calls
question_paraphrase: Claude Code ~60s client timeout during batch element creation; duplicate elements
phrasing_notes: engineering proposal with design section
answer_summary: Replay stored response for same key+args; discussion on data and necessity.

gloss_en: Simple question 'list all pipes in the revit model' makes Claude loop through 'Method ai_element_filter not found' errors.
title_original: Keep getting 'Method XXX not found' errors despite MCP server and Revit plugin working
question_paraphrase: list all pipes in the revit model -> Get element information failed: Method not found
context_given: compiled plugin from source in VS
phrasing_notes: experienced Revit API dev, quotes Claude's successive answers
answer_summary: Registry mismatch between server and plugin versions; reply suggested aligning them.

gloss_en: How to connect Mistral or Llama instead of Claude to the Revit MCP.
title_original: How Can i connect mistral or Llama with the revit MCP
question_paraphrase: one-line question
phrasing_notes: very short, no context
answer_summary: Any MCP-capable client works; need an MCP client between model and server (e.g. Aider+MCP).

gloss_en: Asks for a simple tutorial combining revit-mcp and revit-mcp-plugin for users unfamiliar with MCP.
title_original: Could you please provide a simple tutorial?
question_paraphrase: Dear authors..., assuming users are not very familiar with MCP
phrasing_notes: very polite, addressing authors by handle
answer_summary: Maintainers promised a wiki page 'Driving Revit through MCP'.

gloss_en: World moves fast; worried that Revit plugin developers will lose their jobs to MCP.
title_original: 世界发展真快 马上二开要失业了
question_paraphrase: 二开 (secondary development) will be unemployed soon
phrasing_notes: slang 二开, exclamatory, two short lines
answer_summary: Reply: demand for well-wrapped low-level commands will rise; AI handles scenarios.

gloss_en: How to connect this Revit MCP to Cursor?
question_paraphrase: title only
phrasing_notes: title-only issue, no body
answer_summary: Add MCP server in Cursor settings with command python -u path to xml_revit_mcp_server.py.

gloss_en: Startup error; reporter found commenting out the description line makes it run.
question_paraphrase: 亲测将description代码行注释掉即可正确运行
phrasing_notes: screenshot plus one-line workaround
answer_summary: Workaround: comment out description line.

gloss_en: Example prompts for Bonsai MCP: model summary, spatial structure, wall area, CSV export, place door, georeference, floor-plan PNG, BC3 budget in Spanish.
question_paraphrase: Georeference this IFC model using EPSG:4326... Generate a BC3 budget file in Spanish
phrasing_notes: README prompts, imperative, quantity and georef heavy
answer_summary: Limits: arbitrary code tool, timeouts on large models, base64 screenshots.

gloss_en: Good prompts: summarize model, count walls/doors/spaces/psets, find missing names and classifications, CSV room-area report, create simple IFC, open viewer, apply BCF.
question_paraphrase: Find missing names, classifications, and suspicious property values in this IFC file.
phrasing_notes: imperative with file path; Windows path for BCF
answer_summary: Large files can take over a minute; cancelling does not stop Python.

gloss_en: Architects drag an IFC into Claude and ask: how many fire doors on Level 2, validate materials, concrete quantities, what changed since last week, convert to GLB.
question_paraphrase: How many fire doors are on Level 2?
phrasing_notes: table of 'You ask / It does' in plain English
answer_summary: 8 tools: query, stats, properties, spaces, validate, compare, quantities, GLB.

gloss_en: Design rule 'model proposes, code executes': room areas, door widths, fire doors checked deterministically, UNKNOWN instead of guesses, exported as CSV or BCF 2.1.
question_paraphrase: model_summary, check_door_widths(min 850), run_rules, export_issues
phrasing_notes: explicit anti-hallucination language
answer_summary: Tools instruct the model never to estimate numbers; PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN.

gloss_en: Business case: glass cleaner asks largest window, workers ask walls above a height, painters ask total wall area, architect asks counts of chimneys and ramps.
question_paraphrase: how many windows, doors, chimneys, or ramps
phrasing_notes: persona-driven non-expert questions
answer_summary: Supports inventory, counts, property filters, sums, min/max.

gloss_en: Spanish prompts: what elements do I have selected in Archicad; create four 3 m walls forming a 5x4 m rectangle.
question_paraphrase: Creá cuatro muros de 3 m de alto formando un rectángulo de 5 × 4 m
phrasing_notes: rioplatense voseo 'Creá'; metric units
answer_summary: Undo cannot be grouped; zone auto-placement only on the open floor; 120 s timeout.

gloss_en: Run electrical or HVAC takeoff on the current selection; show only ducts and fittings with size, length, area, gauge and kilos.
question_paraphrase: Ejecuta la corrida 5 HVAC sobre mi selección actual en modo detalle.
phrasing_notes: imperative Spanish, 'corrida' jargon for takeoff runs
answer_summary: Fittings area direct, geometric estimate or fallback factor, method reported.

gloss_en: Wants AI to export model health, preview then apply missing door/window marks, find duplicate room numbers and unplaced views, always with preview, confirm, apply, log, undo.
question_paraphrase: 面向 Revit 使用者、BIM 团队、插件开发者
phrasing_notes: project plan in Chinese; human-in-the-loop emphasis
answer_summary: Each model change: dry-run, confirmation, apply, log, undo check.

gloss_en: Fine-tuned a small model on 42,680 IFC Q&A examples; errors remain: confusing WHERE rules, mixing attribute names, repetition, wrong general answers.
question_paraphrase: 建物の設計データに関する質問に答えられるよう、AIモデルを追加学習させた実験
phrasing_notes: Japanese research note, metrics, explicit caveats
answer_summary: ROUGE/BLEU improved but do not prove factual correctness.

gloss_en: Open-source scheduler with IFC 4.3 as native format; comment says connect Claude/ChatGPT to prepare and edit plans.
question_paraphrase: Connect to Claude/ ChatGPT and let the AI model prepare and edit plans!
phrasing_notes: enthusiast announcement with exclamation
answer_summary: Plans merge with models in IfcOpenShell or Bonsai.

gloss_en: In a bSDD session thread, a member links a demo of ChatGPT writing GraphQL queries for bSDD.
question_paraphrase: demo of ChatGPT writing GraphQL queries for bSDD
phrasing_notes: short link-sharing post
answer_summary: LLMs seen as a way to query bSDD.

gloss_en: Author prompts: create model Campus; project with site, building HQ, two storeys; concrete wall type 200 mm and exterior walls around a 20x12 m rectangle; classify all walls Uniclass.
question_paraphrase: place exterior walls around a 20x12m rectangle on the ground floor
phrasing_notes: natural-language authoring examples with numbers
answer_summary: Validates references, IDS rules, exports glTF preview.

gloss_en: Prompts: list warnings and affected elements; find walls on Level 02 and propose batch Comments update; approval in Revit before apply. Not yet verified live.
question_paraphrase: Find walls on Level 02, show their Comments values, and propose a batch update.
phrasing_notes: cautious, explicit limits list
answer_summary: IFC provider read-only; undo one action at a time.

gloss_en: Early IFC MCP with 7 tools: entities, properties, location, elements in a spatial container, openings on a wall, space boundaries.
question_paraphrase: get_openings_on_wall, get_space_boundaries
phrasing_notes: academic repo, demo GIF
answer_summary: Streamable HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:8000.

gloss_en: Sparx fork of revit-mcp: tools for view elements, ai_element_filter, create doors/walls/floors, tag, color by parameter, send_code_to_revit.
question_paraphrase: dimension every wall on this view; check the curtain-wall elevations
phrasing_notes: tool list heavy
answer_summary: Commands must be enabled manually in Revit settings.

gloss_en: Japanese Revit MCP aims at operations under Japanese standards like the Building Standards Act; schedules via HTML/Excel round trip.
question_paraphrase: 日本独自の基準・法規に沿った運用設計
phrasing_notes: formal Japanese disclaimer style
answer_summary: Queries, parameter edits, move/rotate/delete, schedule export/import with verification.

gloss_en: Vietnamese toolkit: Claude builds levels, walls, rooms from description or AutoCAD drawing; second part counts doors, rooms, quantities, exports Excel.
question_paraphrase: Thống kê cửa, phòng; khối lượng tường, sàn
phrasing_notes: Vietnamese README, try on draft model first
answer_summary: Command via pyrevit agent run fixed scripts.

gloss_en: Install prompt for agents and built-in prompts: model_audit, pre_issue_check, stairs; list known agent mistakes such as guessing target, case-sensitive parameters.
question_paraphrase: Find affected elements and group warnings by description
phrasing_notes: agent-facing instructions
answer_summary: Interrupted writes require inspecting model before repeating.

gloss_en: Bonsai MCP variant warns that general execute_code behaves unpredictably with IFC operations and may not save; recommends disabling it.
question_paraphrase: create a wall between two 3D points
phrasing_notes: warning-heavy
answer_summary: Must save an empty .ifc first and click Connect in the add-on.

gloss_en: Prompts like dimension every wall and check curtain-wall elevations; troubleshooting list: port 8964, HTTP.sys PID 4, one AI client at a time, browser Origin blocked.
question_paraphrase: 切換/釋放連線; MCP 設定
phrasing_notes: zh-TW UI labels
answer_summary: Exclusive lock returns HTTP 409 to a second client.

gloss_en: How many elements are proxies and where from
prompt: how many IfcBuildingElementProxy in here and what revit category did they come from
expected_behavior: Count proxies, group by Pset/ObjectType/Revit category, report counts and suggest remapping.

gloss_en: Check all doors for min clear width 850 and list failures
prompt: check every door in the model for clear width >= 850mm, give me a list of failures with storey and GUID, dont guess if the data is missing
expected_behavior: Run door width check, return PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN with GlobalId, storey; mark missing widths UNKNOWN.

gloss_en: This IFC you generated will not open in Bonsai
prompt: the ifc you wrote wont open in bonsai, validate it and fix till it passes
expected_behavior: Run schema validation, report errors such as wrong attribute counts, repair and re-validate.

gloss_en: Net wall area by storey, CSV
prompt: net wall area per storey excl openings, csv pls. say which qto source you used
expected_behavior: Group walls by storey, use Qto NetSideArea else compute, export CSV, state source.

gloss_en: Create wall on Level 2 not Level 1
prompt: draw a 6m wall on level 2 from 0,0 to 6000,0 - make sure its really on level 2 and type is generic 200
expected_behavior: Resolve Level by name, wall type by name, create wall, read back level and elevation.

gloss_en: List all pipes and their system types
prompt: list all pipes in the model with system type and diameter
expected_behavior: Query pipes, group by system type, return diameters; do not loop on failed methods.

gloss_en: How many walls on each floor?
prompt: 这个ifc里每层有多少面墙？按楼层列一下，顺便看有没有没挂到楼层的
expected_behavior: Count IfcWall by storey via containment, list unassigned walls.

gloss_en: Create walls from CAD layer
prompt: 把dwg里A-WALL那层的双线墙翻成revit墙，先预览中心线和厚度再建，别建到一层去
expected_behavior: Preview centerlines and widths, confirm, create walls on the specified level.

gloss_en: MCP connected but no Revit data
prompt: cursor里mcp是绿的但revit没反应，8964端口被占了？怎么查
expected_behavior: Check plugin running, port conflict, one client lock, config path.

gloss_en: Which elements lack Mark?
prompt: глянь у каких стен и дверей нет марки (Mark/Tag), список с гуидами и этажом
expected_behavior: Query walls/doors with empty Mark/Tag, return GUID, storey.

gloss_en: Concrete volume per floor
prompt: объём бетона по этажам, только монолит, ВОР в эксель. если в модели нет Qto - скажи прямо
expected_behavior: Aggregate concrete volumes per storey from Qto or computed, export, flag missing quantities.

gloss_en: Claude does not see Revit
prompt: клод пишет не могу подключиться к ревиту, плагин вроде стоит, что проверить
expected_behavior: Verify plugin started, port, client config and restart, Revit has an open project.

gloss_en: List columns and beams by level
prompt: 階ごとの柱と梁の数を出して、断面サイズ別に集計して
expected_behavior: Count IfcColumn/IfcBeam per storey, group by profile.

gloss_en: Fill empty room names
prompt: 部屋名が空のものを一覧にして、変更案を出してから反映してください
expected_behavior: List rooms with empty Name, propose edits, apply only after approval, read back.

gloss_en: HVAC duct takeoff
prompt: dame los ductos por nivel con longitud, area y kilos, solo los de la selección
expected_behavior: Run takeoff on selection, group by level, report method used.

gloss_en: Create rectangle of walls
prompt: creá cuatro muros de 3 m en rectángulo 5x4 y después contame cuántos hay
expected_behavior: Create four walls, count, report; avoid duplicates on retry.

gloss_en: How do I let Claude read my IFC?
prompt: can claude open ifc files directly or do i need an mcp server? which one for beginners
expected_behavior: Explain IFC is not natively readable; need IFC MCP; recommend local read-only server.
